headline: Exchanges Shed $3.48 Billion In A 1.379 Percent Outflow As Coins Leave Venues
narrative: Exchanges posted a 24-hour net outflow of $3.48 billion, 1.379 percent, and coins left the venues. That pipe is accumulation: Bitcoin reserves on exchanges fell 6,567.37 coins over seven days, to 1,258,899.07. Bitcoin traded near 78k as that supply left the exchanges.
author: jordan
